list.emptyBody: Agents can phone a business to book an appointment, follow up with a lead, or call you when a question can't wait. Calls are set up in Godmode on your computer.

new.title: New call
new.intro: Godmode's voice calls for you and works toward the goal. You get the transcript, a summary and the outcome afterwards.
new.goalPlaceholder: Book a haircut for next week, ideally Tuesday or Wednesday after 5 pm.
new.contextPlaceholder: Customer number, what's been agreed before, what not to say yes to.
new.confirmBody: Godmode calls {{name}} now as your assistant and works toward your goal. The transcript and summary show up here when the call ends.
new.offBody: Turn on phone calls in Godmode on your computer (Settings → Phone calls). Then you can place calls from here.
